labels.moduleOff: This module is switched off in Settings → Enabled modules (it is OFF by default).
labels.intro: Completed orders are sent to the accounting program once each. A private customer is booked on one general customer (no personal data leaves the CRM); a company with a registration number is booked by its number. Only an administrator can change these settings.
labels.enqueue: Queue completed orders of the period
labels.missingList: Completed orders that never reached the queue
labels.driftList: Sent, but the order changed afterwards (correct it in the accounting program, e.g. with a credit note)
labels.testModeOn: TEST MODE: requests go to a fake server, not to the provider.
labels.verifyNote: Not yet verified on a live account of the program - run the owner checklist in docs/ACCOUNTING_INTEGRATIONS.md on a TEST company first.

fields.accountingMeritIban: Merit bank account (IBAN) for later payments
fields.accountingItemCodeBase: Item code of the base wash
fields.accountingDueDays: Days to pay for invoiced orders
fields.accountingVatId21: Program id of the 21% VAT (blank = find it)
fields.accountingVatId0: Program id of the 0% VAT (blank = find it)

hints.accountingStartDate: Nothing before this date is ever sent. Empty = nothing is sent automatically.
hints.accountingMode: Manual: only what you queue. Automatic: every completed order is queued and sent within minutes. Batch: queued at once, sent after the batch time.
hints.accountingRetailName: Shown in the program as the buyer of every private sale.
hints.accountingPayMethodCash: Must already exist in the program (Merit: payment method; SmartAccounts: payment method).
hints.accountingMeritId: Settings → API Settings in Merit. The key is never shown again.

accountingMode.batch: Batch at the end of the day
